ce_bugs.text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:19 — Imported feed/HTML is stored with cook_method raw_html and rendered via `raw post.cooked`, so any RSS item or scraped page containing <script>/onerror yields stored XSS on the forum.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:45 — import_remote calls open-uri `open(url)` which follows redirects, so an attacker posts http://embeddable-host/redirect?to=http://169.254.169.254/ and the forum fetches internal URLs despite the host check in TopicRetriever#invalid_host?.

lib/topic_retriever.rb:26 — Throttle key is `retrieved:<embed_url>`, so an attacker hitting embed/best with unlimited unique URLs on the embeddable host (…?a=1,2,3) bypasses the 60s limit entirely and drives unbounded outbound fetches and topic creation.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:16 — TOCTOU between `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url:).first` and `create!` under the unique index: a retrieve job and PollFeed racing on the same URL raise RecordNotUnique, rolling back the topic and failing the job.

lib/post_revisor.rb:85 — @post.save(validate: false)` return value is ignored and TopicEmbed.import then unconditionally does `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, ...)`, so a failed update is recorded as synced and never retried.

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:41 — Spec asserts `TopicRetriever.expects(:new)` although the controller enqueues Jobs::RetrieveTopic; it only passes via inline job execution and asserts nothing about the enqueue payload or the host guard.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:57 — absolutize_urls only rewrites hrefs/srcs starting with `/`, leaving `javascript:` and protocol-relative URLs untouched in raw_html posts.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` has no read timeout and open-uri falls back to Kernel#open, so a slow or `|command` URL hangs or executes in the Sidekiq worker.

app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:4 — embed.js assumes host page defines discourseUrl/discourseEmbedUrl and a #discourse-comments element, and throws (appendChild on null) with no guard or documented contract
lib/tasks/disqus.thor:117 — The --category/-c option was removed without deprecation, so existing disqus import invocations now fail with an unknown-option error
lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — Topic creation switched to TopicEmbed.import_remote, silently dropping the imported created_at and requiring live network fetches of every thread link
app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:14 — Controller enqueues Jobs::RetrieveTopic but the accompanying spec asserts TopicRetriever.new is called directly; caller contract mismatch
app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:16 — Loading response is served with discourse_expires_in 1.minute, so third-party/CDN caches may pin the placeholder page after the topic exists

db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — Editing an already-released migration to add `force: true` silently DROPs an existing populated top_topics table on any re-run (db:migrate:redo, staging rebuilds).

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:6 — embed_url` is a plain `t.string` (varchar(255)) yet stores arbitrary article URLs; longer URLs raise/truncate on insert and the unique btree index has no length guard.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:31 — embed.update_column(:content_sha1, ...)` runs outside a transaction with the post revision, so a failed revise! can leave sha1 and post content out of sync (no backfill/repair path).
db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:4 — already-shipped migration edited to add `force: true`, silently dropping an existing top_topics table on replay
spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:44 — spec expects `TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve` but the controller enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`, so the test cannot pass
app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:5 — no guard for a missing `#discourse-comments` element or undefined `discourseUrl`/`discourseEmbedUrl` globals; script throws on the host page
app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — open(url).read` in import_remote has no open/read timeout or size limit, so a slow or huge remote page can hang a Sidekiq worker indefinitely.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` has no timeout, so a hung feed server stalls the scheduled job (and, via TopicRetriever, a request-triggered job) with no recovery.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — Redis throttle uses non-atomic SETNX+EXPIRE; a crash between the two leaves `retrieved:<url>` with no TTL, permanently blocking retrieval of that embed URL.
app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:9 — The loading page reloads every 30s unconditionally with no attempt cap, so any permanently failing retrieval creates an infinite reload loop hammering the server.
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — No per-item rescue: one item with nil `content`/`title` or a failing import aborts the whole feed poll, silently skipping all remaining items.
app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb:10 — RetrieveTopic has no error handling around network retrieval; open-uri failures propagate and Sidekiq default-retries the fetch up to 25 times per embed URL.

app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:5 — No null check on `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')`; if the container is missing or the script runs before it, `comments.appendChild` throws and the embed never loads.

app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:11 — postMessage` targetOrigin is the full `request.referer` URL (or blank when absent), which fails origin matching so the parent never receives the resize and the iframe stays collapsed.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:24 — creator.create` failure is silently swallowed inside the transaction (no error surfaced/logged), so failed imports look like successes and are retried forever.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:13 — contents << ...` mutates the caller's string in place, so a retried/repeated import appends the footer again and changes the SHA1, causing spurious revisions.
app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:19 — discourse_expires_in 1.minute` caches the transient `loading` response, so a client may keep seeing a stale loading page after the topic exists.

app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:10 — The postMessage resize handshake (layout sender + embed.js origin check/height application) has no JS or view test; the loose `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin)` check would pass an incorrect-origin test unnoticed.
